articles.title: U.S. regulator says 24/7 trading is great for crypto, may not be fit for other sectors
articles.snippet: As the CFTC issued landmark approvals for crypto perpetual futures contracts, it explained in a related advisory that round-the-clock activity isn't right for all.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC opens crypto 'perp' door with first approvals at Kalshi, Coinbase
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has now established a stance on how regulated U.S. firms can engage in crypto perpetual futures contracts.

articles.title: Bitwise bets Hyperliquid could power future finance as HYPE ETFs gain traction
articles.snippet: Bitwise says investor demand for Hyperliquid exposure is surging as new HYPE ETFs launch.

articles.title: Hyperliquid's pre-IPO SpaceX contracts suffer 45% flash crash, liquidating $1.5 million
articles.snippet: A massive selloff in a SpaceX crypto token wiped out hundreds of retail traders in 30 minutes because the market lacked enough cash to absorb the shock.

articles.title: NYSE parent ICE pushes ‘level playing field’ for 24/7 onchain perps
articles.snippet: ICE’s CEO said regulators need to create a “level playing field” for launching 24/7 onchain perps contracts, which are already trading on exchanges such as Hyperliquid.
